class.name: FellowFootLock3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a character's feet held where they come down while the animation under them would slide them — a blend of two gaits, a turn, a start or a stop.
class.description: A modifier of the character's [Skeleton3D], after the animation's (an [AnimationTree] or [AnimationPlayer] plays under it). Each foot is locked where its sole comes down — under the heel or under the ball (the toe bone's joint), whichever is lower, within [member contact_height] of the ground (the skeleton's origin's height: a character standing on its origin; a skeleton whose feet rest more than 0.1 m below its origin, as a mocap rig resting on its hips, has its sole points found from its feet's lowest joint at rest). While locked, the foot is moved across the ground by as much as the animation moves that point: the heel's and the ball's roll stay the animation's and only their slide is taken out, by two-bone IK on the leg (the foot's parent and grandparent bones; the knee in its animated plane, the foot keeping its animated turn). From the heel to the ball the lock is handed over where the ball is shown. A foot is let go when the animation lifts it or pulls it further than [member unlock_radius] from the lock, and returns to the animated foot over [member blend_halflife]. Let go, it is never eased back from further from the hip than the leg reaches (99 % of it, or as far as the animation puts the foot): a body speeding away does not leave its knee straight (milestone 156). A blend of two gaits mixes the same moment of their strides, but not of their stances: a walk's foot is down while a run's is in the air, and the blend drags the foot over the ground. Held, it stays where it came down. Give it its weight with [member SkeletonModifier3D.influence]: on the ground, not in the air or while another modifier poses the legs. Placed elsewhere (a cut), call [method reset]. See [code]docs/decisions/0295-legs-that-bear-weight.md[/code].

method.name: get_slide
method.description: Metres the shown [param foot] (0 left, 1 right) has moved across the ground while down since the last [method reset].

method.name: is_locked
method.description: [code]true[/code] while [param foot] (0 left, 1 right) is held where it came down.

method.name: reset
method.description: Lets go of both feet at once (no blend back from where they were) and clears [method get_slide]: for a character placed elsewhere.

members.member: The seconds in which a foot let go halves its way back to the animated foot (a critically damped spring).

How close to the ground (metres) the sole under the heel or the ball comes for the foot to be down. A foot the animation brings to the ground faster than it stops is grabbed early by a high value and held short of where it lands.
How far behind the ankle (metres, away from the toe) the sole under the heel is.
The left foot's bone; its parent is the lower leg, its grandparent the upper.
The left foot's toes' bone (its joint is the ball). Empty: the foot is held by its heel only.

A held foot is also let go when holding it needs more than this share of the leg's length (thigh and shin) from the hip: near full length the knee's angle swings with every millimetre the hip moves. [code]1.0[/code] (the default): never for that. Milestone 172 (decision 0314): over transitions of CMU mocap, [code]0.98[/code] cut the legs' angular acceleration's 95th percentile from 4.2 to 1.7 times the animation's own, at the cost of half the time held (and of the sliding taken out).
The right foot's bone; its parent is the lower leg, its grandparent the upper.
The right foot's toes' bone (its joint is the ball). Empty: the foot is held by its heel only.
How far (metres) the animation may pull a locked foot from where it is held before it is let go.
